description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends Endpoint and implements CRUD operations for managing employee immigration records, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting immigration records via REST API endpoints. It uses annotations to specify OpenAPI documentation for each endpoint and contains methods for validation, service interaction, and data handling related to employee immigration data.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for managing employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM system. It supports CRUD operations such as listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting immigration records associated with employees.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService instance used to perform business logic related to employee immigration records.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list all immigration records for a specific employee, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' method parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add a new immigration record for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new immigration record.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules applicable to the body of create and update requests for immigration records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove immigration records for an employee based on record IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific immigration record of an employee identified by record ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing immigration record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an immigration record.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyImmigrations
methods.description: Creates or updates an EmployeeImmigrationRecord instance based on request data, handling both new record creation and existing record update.
